resolved_findings.title: Correct the malformed near-resonance integral
resolved_findings.finding: The first read contained an integral upper limit written as int_0^t Big|_(t=T).
resolved_findings.resolution: The writer changed it to the required integral from 0 to T of |Omega|s. The current display was re-read and yields |Omega|T^2/2.

resolved_findings.title: Qualify rectangles by the anisotropic metric
resolved_findings.finding: The final sentence says rational spectra allow tilted rectangles without changing from the ordinary integer-frequency coordinates. For unequal beta coefficients, resonance gives weighted orthogonality, not Euclidean orthogonality. The irrational axis-parallel proof itself is correct.
resolved_findings.counterexample: For beta=(1,2), choose k=(0,0), k1=(2,1), k3=(1,-1), k2=(3,0). Momentum and frequency sums agree: 6+3=9. The adjacent edge vectors have Euclidean dot product 1, not 0. In fact a non-axis Euclidean rectangle cannot be resonant for unequal beta1,beta2.
resolved_findings.correction: Use the inner product beta1*a1*b1+beta2*a2*b2, or rescale frequencies by diag(sqrt(beta1),sqrt(beta2)); call the unscaled configuration a parallelogram. Alternatively restrict the comparison sentence to the square torus.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: Satisfied: correction, cited-source scope and actual prerequisite destinations reviewed; parent-confirmed packet and all reviewed hashes unchanged at final acceptance.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4L06 now gives weighted orthogonality beta1*v1*w1+beta2*v2*w2=0 and diagonal square-root rescaling. Non-axis Euclidean rectangles are asserted only for the square torus.

resolved_findings.title: Retarget measure and convergence labels to the actual definitions and theorems
resolved_findings.finding: 4L0E and 4L0Q link the label Lebesgue measure to 00Q4, whose actual content defines null sets and almost-everywhere statements. 4L0X links Lebesgue convergence theorems to 00Q5, which defines the integral but contains neither convergence theorem.
resolved_findings.correction: Use 00XV for Lebesgue measure; retain 00Q4 only under a null-set label. In 4L0X use 0I8I for dominated convergence and 0A7A for monotone convergence. These exact destinations were read. Also link the mixed-channel energy cancellation to 4L0T when discussing all three channels, rather than only the two-to-two identity 4L0G.

resolved_findings.title: Require an unbounded dispersion or restrict the inverse variable to its range
resolved_findings.finding: Strict increase, continuity, omega(0)=0 and omega'(r)>0 do not imply that omega maps onto [0,infinity). Nevertheless r(x), Gamma(x), F(x) and the displayed integral are used on that whole half-line.
resolved_findings.counterexample: omega(r)=r/(1+r) satisfies every listed hypothesis, but r(x) exists only for 0<=x<1.
resolved_findings.correction: Add omega(r)->infinity as r->infinity (and preferably a clear C1 change-of-variable hypothesis), or integrate over the actual range and explicitly extend the pushed-forward density by zero.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: Satisfied: correction, cited-source scope and actual prerequisite destinations reviewed; parent-confirmed packet and all reviewed hashes unchanged at final acceptance.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4L0H adds unboundedness at infinity, continuity, positive-half-line C1 regularity and strictly positive derivative. Its inverse therefore has the full declared range; Gamma is initially defined only for x>0.

resolved_findings.title: Specify the measure-solution contract instead of leaving its defining functional implicit
resolved_findings.finding: The displayed identity contains an undefined C_phi on measures with atoms. The following sentence delegates both its boundary interpretation and all time regularity to the papers. Consequently this Definition does not yet specify the solution class used in the condensation and energy-loss theorems, and different pure/mixed models are folded into one unnamed functional.
resolved_findings.correction: State the exact imported solution class separately for each model, including the source's time regularity, test class, collision functional, integrability and zero-frequency convention. Give local formulas or a precise, model-specific source definition and equation interface; if the paper leaves a point implicit, disclose that limitation rather than inventing an extension. A full existence or condensation proof is not requested. Link Borel/Radon terminology to the actual definitions.

evidence.detail: The definition explicitly specifies C1 time dependence of the radial measure and its test identity.
The mixed model adds the condition phi'(0)=0 and explicit time regularity.
The source identifies the mixed functional through model-specific integral terms; the note currently leaves that interface implicit.

resolved_findings.title: Name the weighted topology needed to pass conservation to a truncation limit
resolved_findings.finding: Strong convergence together with a uniform weighted bound is not, without specifying the topology or a uniform tail condition, sufficient to pass equality of weighted moments to the limit. The finite-system algebra and norm comparison are correct.
resolved_findings.counterexample: For s>1, a^(N)=(1+N^2)^(-s/2)e_(N,0) converges strongly to zero in ell2 and has uniformly bounded hs norm, but its separable weighted moment tends to 1 whereas the limit's moment is 0.
resolved_findings.correction: Require strong convergence in the relevant weighted ell2 space (hs for the displayed nonnegative weight), or uniform weighted-tail control. If only unweighted strong convergence and a bounded hs moment are available, assert the lower-semicontinuity inequality, not equality. Name or link the convergence notion used.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: Satisfied: correction, cited-source scope and actual prerequisite destinations reviewed; parent-confirmed packet and all reviewed hashes unchanged at final acceptance.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4L07 explicitly requires strong hs convergence at each tested time and at the initial time to pass weighted conservation to a limit. It distinguishes the lower-semicontinuity conclusion available from unweighted convergence plus a uniform hs bound.

resolved_findings.title: State the forward time interval in the stability lemma
resolved_findings.finding: No time interval is specified, but the integral inequality and exponential bound are only written for t>=0. They are false as displayed for negative time.
resolved_findings.counterexample: F=0, u(t)=0, v(t)=t, r=1, delta=0 and L=0 give |t|<=t in the stated L=0 conclusion, which fails for t<0.
resolved_findings.correction: State that the curves and residual bound are given on [0,T] and that the conclusion holds for 0<=t<=T; use |t| and reversed integration if a two-sided version is intended.
resolved_findings.acceptance_condition: Satisfied: correction, cited-source scope and actual prerequisite destinations reviewed; parent-confirmed packet and all reviewed hashes unchanged at final acceptance.
resolved_findings.resolution: 4L0A fixes T>0, assumes both curves and residual estimates on [0,T], and restricts the conclusion to 0<=t<=T.
